pastJobsText.title: Facebook Ad Content Creator Needed for Teeth Whitening Brand
pastJobsText.description: Hi there, We are looking for a skilled full stack content creator to help build winning ads for our Australian teeth whitening brands facebook ad campaigns. The role will be creating winning ads from start to finish, including ideation, script writing, and editing. We are looking for someone who has a strong understand of not only how to edit, but is up to date with the latest AI tools like eleven labs, veo 3/sora 2. We are currently spending around $3-$4k AUD a month on facebook, but don't have any standout winning ads. We are looking for someone who is able to produce high level creatives on a frequent basis to consistently pump out fresh creatives and help us scale. Our audience is mainly females 20-60 You can see our ad library here: https://www.facebook.com/ads/library/?active_status=active&ad_type=all&country=AU&is_targeted_country=false&media_type=all&search_type=page&view_all_page_id=104767821498916 And our content bank here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-CYYXZkE1koen3sfInvu2GiwmTTM_BOP?usp=sharing Please submit something for me to see when you apply. If you have no portfolio, I won't be able to consider your application. Looking forward to working with you long term Budget is just a placeholder until we discuss output & contract length!

pastJobsText.title: Google Ad Expert Required To Scale Past Plateau
pastJobsText.description: Thanks for checking out our job post! We are an Australian based teeth whitening company looking for an experienced Google ads expert to help us scale up our Google ads. We are currently spending $5kAUD per month, but have struggled to get past this profitably. Responsibilities: • Review our current Google Ads campaigns and provide detailed feedback. • Identify any issues and suggest improvements. • Confidently continue running and optimizing our Google Ads campaigns. • Provide strategic insights to improve campaign performance and ROI. • Monitor and report on campaign performance. Requirements: • Proven experience as a Google Ads Specialist. • Strong understanding of Google Ads best practices and strategies. • Ability to analyze and interpret campaign data. • Excellent communication skills. • Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills. Process: Before making a hiring decision, we would like to have a call with potential candidates to: • Review our current Google Ads campaigns. • Get your feedback on the current performance. • Discuss your confidence in managing and optimizing our campaigns. • Identify any issues and suggest potential improvements. If we are satisfied with your assessment and advice, we will consider bringing you on board full-time to manage our Google Ads campaigns.
